description.zh: 读取白板上的便签、图形与框架，创建和整理内容并生成汇总。适合把头脑风暴结果带进对话。首次连接在浏览器登录 Miro 授权。
description.en: Read sticky notes, shapes, and frames on a board, create and rearrange content, and summarize it. Good for bringing a brainstorming session into conversation. Sign in to Miro in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Miro 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Miro and authorize on first connect
